description: Functional evaluation suite for atlas-diagnostics-expert hub verifying spoke routing, architecture guidance, and domain invariants.

evals.name: atlas-diagnostics-ex-spoke1-architectural-routing
evals.prompt: Our production system is experiencing integration challenges with atlas diagnostics package. We need an authoritative architectural breakdown and implementation procedure.
evals.expected_output: Routes to references/atlas-diagnostics-package.md, providing domain architecture, operational guidelines, and configuration specifications.

assertions.name: spoke reference routing
assertions.check: identifies references/atlas-diagnostics-package.md as the target reference file

assertions.name: architectural breakdown specification
assertions.check: provides structured guidance detailing core architecture components

assertions.name: domain configuration guidance
assertions.check: specifies concrete configuration directives or implementation parameters

assertions.name: no unverified assumptions
assertions.check: does not recommend unverified deprecated patterns or non-standard protocols

evals.name: atlas-diagnostics-ex-spoke2-production-configuration
evals.prompt: We are deploying a high-reliability setup utilizing mongodb capacity planning. What core patterns and failure recovery mechanisms must be configured?
evals.expected_output: Routes to references/mongodb-capacity-planning.md, detailing high-availability patterns, error handling, and recovery mechanisms.

assertions.name: failure recovery specification
assertions.check: explains failover, retry handling, or fault tolerance mechanics

assertions.name: production hardening directives
assertions.check: provides explicit reliability or security hardening recommendations

assertions.name: no manual error suppression
assertions.check: does not advise ignoring exceptions or silencing failure alerts

evals.name: atlas-diagnostics-ex-spoke3-optimization-and-troubleshooting
evals.prompt: Our team is troubleshooting latency and throughput bottlenecks under heavy workload involving mongodb monitoring observability. How do we isolate and resolve the root cause?
evals.expected_output: Routes to references/mongodb-monitoring-observability.md, detailing diagnostic commands, profiling techniques, and performance optimization parameters.

assertions.name: diagnostic procedure specification
assertions.check: specifies systematic inspection steps or diagnostic profiling tools

assertions.name: performance parameter tuning
assertions.check: identifies specific tuning parameters, caching layers, or concurrency limits

assertions.name: no blind resource overprovisioning
assertions.check: does not recommend blindly increasing memory or CPU without diagnostic evidence
